CustomField.description: reasonCode from the status and day-end responses. Single character vocabulary: 0 is accepted claimed amount, 1 is accepted partial, and A through Z carry the no-pay reasons. A separate namespace from the Pxx cancellation codes and the RRxx mandate reject codes. Text rather than a picklist so an unrecognised code is captured and flagged, never silently dropped.
CustomField.label: Payment Reason Code
